name: Playlist
author: Worse Code
description: Plays a list of WAV or MP3 tracks sequentially. It requires the Sounds plugin, loops from the first track by default, and can advance to the next track when a configured key is pressed.
example:
playlist
track "1" = "1.wav"
track "2" = "2.wav"
blocklast = true
changenow:key "ENTER"
